description: This file provides helper methods for extracting specific tokens and IDs from HTML input strings in functional web tests, utilizing regular expressions.

classes.name: WebPageHelpers
classes.description: A static helper class providing methods for parsing verification tokens and item IDs from HTML content during web tests.

methods.name: GetRequestVerificationToken
methods.description: Extracts the request verification token from an HTML input string.

methods.name: GetId
methods.description: Extracts the item ID from an HTML input string.

methods.name: RegexSearch
methods.description: Performs a regex match and returns the last captured group from the input string.
